jobs_results.title: Manager, People Operations
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Manager, People Operations to lead Total Rewards, Talent Management, and Core HR services across the AMERICAS region.

This role will lead approximately 8–10 People Operations professionals in Costa Rica, ensuring operational excellence, service quality, compliance, and an exceptional employee experience.

The ideal candidate combines deep Workday Core HCM expertise, strong HR Service Delivery (HRSD) experience, and proven people leadership with a passion for process optimization, automation, and continuous improvement.

A key expectation is to build an engaged ONE TEAM AMERICAS culture, breaking down silos, strengthening collaboration between Costa Rica and West Palm Beach-FL, and promoting shared accountability, knowledge sharing, and business continuity.

Key Responsibilities

 People Leadership, Engagement & OperationsLead, coach, and develop approximately 8–10 People Operations professionals, establishing clear performance expectations, accountability, and a culture of collaboration. Break down functional silos and foster a ONE TEAM mentality, promoting shared ownership, open communication, and stronger relationships across teams. Drive employee engagement through team-building activities, recognition, knowledge-sharing sessions, and events that strengthen morale, trust, and belonging. Oversee daily HR Operations floor management, including workload distribution, capacity planning, case prioritization, productivity, quality assurance, and escalations. Strengthen team capabilities through coaching, cross-training, succession planning, and performance development.  Workday Core HCM & HR Functional ExpertiseProvide hands-on functional leadership in Workday Core HCM, including business processes, employee lifecycle transactions, organizational structures, effective dating, data changes, and troubleshooting. Oversee accurate execution of HR transactions, including hires, transfers, promotions, job and compensation changes, leave-related updates, and terminations, as applicable. Manage operational processes supporting Total Rewards (Compensation and Benefits) and Talent Management (Performance Management and Goals). Partner with HR Technology, HRIS, and COEs to resolve complex issues, optimize Workday processes, and support enhancements and testing.  HR Service Delivery (HRSD) & Service ExcellenceOwn daily HR service delivery through ServiceNow HRSD, ensuring timely, accurate, and consistent resolution of employee inquiries. Manage key operational metrics, including SLA, CSAT, case volumes, aging, backlog, productivity, first-time resolution, and quality. Leverage HRSD dashboards and analytics to identify trends, address service gaps, and drive data-informed decisions. Establish effective case routing, escalation management, quality assurance, knowledge management, and workload balancing practices.  Cross-Regional Collaboration & Business ContinuityPartner closely with the West Palm Beach Tier 2/3 People Operations team to deliver seamless, integrated HR services across Costa Rica and the United States. Promote a ONE TEAM AMERICAS operating model, aligning both locations around shared goals, accountability, service standards, and employee experience. Drive cross-training, knowledge transfer, process documentation, and skills development to strengthen operational flexibility and reduce single points of dependency.  Process Optimization, Automation & Continuous ImprovementIdentify and implement opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and optimize regional and global HR processes. Drive measurable improvements in efficiency, productivity, service quality, and employee experience through process redesign and elimination of non-value-added activities. Identify and quantify capacity savings, productivity gains, time savings, and cost efficiencies, translating improvements into measurable business outcomes. Apply a product mindset, leveraging employee feedback, service data, and the voice of the customer to develop scalable, outcome-focused solutions.  Stakeholder Partnership, Governance & Change ManagementBuild productive partnerships with Global People Operations, HR Business Partners, Total Rewards, Talent Management, HR Technology, and other COEs. Ensure compliance with LATAM employment regulations, HR policies, data privacy requirements, and local labor practices, particularly in Costa Rica. Maintain internal controls, audit readiness, data integrity, process documentation, and confidentiality. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

HR Operations & People Leadership

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Typically 8–10 years of progressive experience in HR Operations, People Services, or HR Shared Services, including Managerial leadership. Experience supporting Americas People Operations, with a strong understanding of the US, LATAM HR landscape and processes, and hands-on exposure to core employee lifecycle activities, including Benefits, Compensation & Rewards, and Talent. Proven ability to manage high-volume HR operations, workload planning, resource utilization, service performance, and escalations. Strong knowledge of LATAM HR policies, employment practices, and regulatory requirements, particularly Costa Rica. 

Workday & Functional HR Expertise

Deep, hands-on Workday Core HCM experience is mandatory, including business processes, lifecycle transactions, effective dating, organizational structures, data changes, and troubleshooting. Strong functional knowledge of Compensation, Benefits, Performance Management, and Goals. 

HRSD, Analytics & Operational Excellence

Hands-on experience with ServiceNow HRSD including case management, workflows, escalations, reporting, and dashboards. Experience managing SLA, CSAT, productivity, case aging, quality, and other operational KPIs. Strong analytical skills to interpret data, identify trends, communicate insights, and recommend improvements. Proven success in process optimization, automation, standardization, and measurable capacity or efficiency gains. 

Leadership Competencies & Attributes

Strong people leadership skills with a passion for coaching, mentoring, employee engagement, and team development. Collaborative and inclusive leadership style promoting ONE TEAM values, trust, shared accountability, and cross-regional partnerships. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and problem-solving skills. Ability to balance strategic improvements with hands-on operational responsibilities. Adaptability, accountability, and resilience in a dynamic, fast-paced global environment. Ability to champion change, manage competing priorities, and deliver projects successfully. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in multinational organizations or global HR Shared Services / Global Business Services environments. Experience with cross-regional operating models. Exposure to HR digital transformation, AI-enabled service delivery, automation, or technology optimization. 

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

Blacksmith Agency




Finance
Full time


Remote (Latin America or South Africa)



About The Role


Blacksmith Agency is a fully remote US digital agency of 30 to 40 people running websites, SEO, paid media and branding. As Director of Finance and Operations you own finance end to end, plus the people operations that go with it, reporting straight to ownership as the senior finance person. You run it on your own.
What You Will Own






Finance: clean books with our bookkeeper, the monthly close, cash, payables, receivables and controls.


FP&A: revenue, margin and cash flow models and forecasts, monthly actual versus forecast, unit economics and the capacity model that says when to hire.


People operations: onboarding and offboarding for a remote team across several countries, contracts, payroll setup, access in and out.


Plain answers for ownership on where the business stands and what to do about it.



What You Need






You have run finance yourself: built the models, owned the close and answered to ownership for the numbers.


Independent and driven. Nobody hands you a checklist.


Strong Google Sheets or Excel, QuickBooks or Xero, and clear written and spoken English.


Full time as your only job, with substantial overlap with US business hours. Services or agency finance is a plus.



How To Apply


Apply in two minutes at the link, then a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment. If you are a fit, you get a link to a short AI interview you can take any time. No cover letter.
